description_text: ***RESTRICTED TO PREQUALIFIED SOURCES*** Qualification Requirements: See RFO Part 52.209-1 The requirements of RFO 9.202(a) apply. As prescribed in RFO 9.202(e), the contracting officer need not delay a proposed award in order to provide a potential offeror with an opportunity to demonstrate its ability to meet the standards specified. Award will not be held up for contractor qualifications. ***SECURITY REQUIREMENTS*** The Contractor shall have and maintain for the duration of the contract a current Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) status at the following CMMC level, or higher: CMMC Level 2 (Self), for all information systems used in performance of the contract, task order, or delivery order that process, store, or transmit FCI or CUI. ***DESCRIPTION*** This requirement is for repairs services for the MUTES program., 1 each, Control Motor, NSN: 6105-01-3256-6234 FD, PN: DPM56DF4-K7710 and 3 each, Drive Azimuth Motor NSN: 6105-01-329-4767 FD, PN: DPM56PF4-K7714.
